name: Proper Ordered Sample Compression / Proper Stable Labeled Sample Compression
details: A proper order scheme becomes stable by fixing the tie-breaking order on retained keys. Reconstruction remains the first compatible hypothesis in the original class, and the compression width is unchanged.
proof_source: Full proof in the LaTeX survey: prop:order-stable-installation, with the ordered hypothesis set equal to the original class.
witness_verification: On the full three-cube, pOSC is three and proper stable labeled compression is two. In general the database-owned endpoint values are $n$ and $\lceil n/2\rceil$, so this is strict but not an unbounded-ratio witness. See sync/verify_order_stable_compression.py and the full-cube value proofs.
